description: B5 additional experiment: start-up of uniaxial extension, Caputo time-fractional FENE-P conformation tensor (Peterlin closure of the time-fractional FENE dumbbell model), C(0) = I; admissible set {C > 0, tr C < b}

variant_definitions.outputs: sym: X = C0 + s g Sym(N); logm: X = expm(log C0 + log(1+s) g Sym(N)); bfactor: X = b S/(1 + tr S), S = T T^T, T = T0 + sqrt(s_S) g N; blogm: X = b S/(1 + tr S), S = expm(log S0 + log(1+s_S) g Sym(N)); S0 = C0/(b - tr C0)
variant_definitions.losses: fro: |R|_F^2/s^2; comp: sum_ij (R_ij/s_ij)^2; rel: |R|_F^2/|X|_F^2; nat: tr(X^-1 R X^-1 R)

scale.rule: from the implicit L1 + Newton solution on a 64-step graded mesh: s = max |C - C0|_F, s_ij component-wise (floored at 1), s_S = max |S - S0|_F with S = C/(b - tr C)

reference.definition: implicit L1 + Newton on graded meshes with N and 2N steps, one Richardson step of order 2 - alpha
